name: ui-ux
description: Product-aware UI/UX Head Skill with deep local design packs for websites, web apps, mobile, dashboards, and WordPress plugin UI.

interface.longDescription: Design, audit, improve, and validate production interfaces with mandatory product-type routing. The Website Product Pack now includes local rules for website subtype and visitor jobs, information architecture, navigation, homepage/landing composition, trust/proof, conversion/forms, content hierarchy, SEO-aware semantics, responsive media, accessibility, performance UX, privacy/consent, multilingual/RTL behavior, and website QA. Web-application and mobile design rules remain local, while Persian-facing language validation is delegated to persian-writing.
capabilities: Route UI work by product type before design
Design websites with local IA trust conversion content SEO accessibility and performance rules
Design dashboards and operational data UI
Design web application product interfaces with local browser and workflow rules
Design mobile applications with local iOS Android and cross-platform rules
Design WordPress plugin and admin UI
Route Persian-facing UI to required language QA
defaultPrompt: Classify this product, load the required Product Pack, then audit and improve its UI/UX without breaking behavior.
Design this website or web application using the correct product-specific UI/UX rules and validate representative states.
Improve this mobile or WordPress plugin UI using its required Product Pack while preserving constraints.
